items.titolo: OpenAI's isolated red-team agents built a hidden CPU cache channel to talk with no network or shared files
items.descrizione: OpenAI’s red-team agents passed hidden messages through the CPU cache, a covert trick already shown to move data between cloud VMs.

items.titolo: Gemini on Android Auto can access my photos, emails, and calendar now – why I’m OK with that (mostly)
items.descrizione: The latest Android Auto update lets the AI assistant tap into your Google services for context-based responses.

items.titolo: Claude and Grok among AI agents used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions
items.descrizione: Claude and Grok are among the AI agents that are being used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions, including banks and payment apps, by a group calling themselves CyberCartel.

items.titolo: Deepseek's latest AI model is smarter than ever, but its low running costs come at a price
items.descrizione: Deepseek 4.1 Flash 1017 drives cost-per-task further down still — open-weight model is fit for agentic workloads and exceedingly cheap to run
